reason: I don't put my clients' receipts into an unknown Telegram bot. If it reads a crumpled nota wrong I still have to check every row myself, and the books are my responsibility, so I am not saving much time for the risk.
objection: Who is behind this bot and where do my clients' documents go? Under UU PDP I am the one in trouble if client data leaks, and I have never heard of this app.
would_change_my_mind: A bookkeeper I know in Bali using it for months without problems, plus a clear statement of who runs it and that the bot keeps no copies outside my own Google Drive.
